DARV.talk.THESORCERESSMOD-THE_SORCERESS_: Well, well, well, ain't you a new face?
I'm only passing through, I'm afraid.
Yeah. Sure. Wouldn't that be somethin'.
Passin' through again, huh? Take one of these. On me.

Hey, good on you for sticking it out, though.
Woulda been easy to give up by now.

Could always walk away.
It'd piss off Neow, but...
Not while this world still suffers.
NEOW.talk.THESORCERESSMOD-THE_SORCERESS_:
I've come to find the master of this place.
And make him stop this madness.

Back again, once more...
I suppose our arrangement continues.
NONUPEIPE.talk.THESORCERESSMOD-THE_SORCE: Who goes there? I don’t recall sending for an escort.
Your guards let me in. It took only a few words.

They must have been convincing words indeed.
Come in then, corvid. You’ve piqued my interest.

Knives, and magic, and blades enchanted for war...
They all have their place. But you and I know our greatest weapon is charm.
For a common raven, you carry yourself with grace.
I will assume that is a compliment.
From me, pretty bird? It is.

You’re certain I can’t convince you to serve a new mistress?
Neow wastes your talents, crashing you against a wall and hoping that it breaks.
Your gifts are appreciated. But I need her power if I’m to claim the future I fight for.
What a shame. But the offer stands, if you ever change your mind.
OROBAS.talk.THESORCERESSMOD-THE_SORCERES: Bird!! Puppet bird! Why puppet? Why bird!?
I was simply born this way.

...And I am my own woman.
No matter what anyone has to say about it.
Wow!! Very good words! You lie and I believe!!
Not-puppet puppet!! Got you shiny! Birds like shiny!
Bird puppet! Don’t fight Architect! No good fight!

A mad king threatens what the people have built.
How could I stand by and do nothing?
Threaten bad! Fight worse! Cycle of violence!!
You can’t escape the cycle by letting the boot stomp on your face.
PAEL.talk.THESORCERESSMOD-THE_SORCERESS_: At the risk of seeming glib... you're melting.

I worry that it bothers [b]you[/b].
And even more that it does not.

[thinky_dots]Why would it?
I sleep, and I am content...[/thinky_dots]

[thinky_dots]You won't accept things as they are.
I will still offer what comfort I can...[/thinky_dots]
If I believe I can change nothing, it will be true.

[thinky_dots]So small, and so desperate to matter.
Take what you will, and leave me to my rest...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.THESORCERESSMOD-THE_SORCERESS_: DAGGERS! AGAIN!! MY DISAPPOINTMENT IS INFINITE!!!
When my strength is not sufficient, I call upon the might of sorcery.
WEAPONS! TAKE A WEAPON! DO SWORD MAGIC NEXT TIME!!!
DEAD ALREADY! I THOUGHT YOU WERE STRONGER!
It is true. I have no hope of victory without the aid of a mighty warrior.
TEZCATARA.talk.THESORCERESSMOD-THE_SORCE: It is nice to find somewhere warm, at least.
Ah. My apologies. I didn't mean to intrude.

Not at all, not at all! Come in and make yourself at home.
I'm always happy to welcome a [jitter][b]kindred spirit[/b][/jitter].
I've seen so many fascinating flames lately, but only one quite like [jitter][b]yours[/b][/jitter].
The others won't say it, but thank you for your restraint, dearie.

If you had your way, you'd cut us all down where we stand!
Just because you [jitter][b]can't[/b][/jitter] doesn't mean I don't appreciate you haven't tried.
You know, a mother's greatest joy is watching her little ones grow.
I have concerns about how you see our relationship.

Oh, dearie, I didn't mean [jitter][b]that[/b][/jitter].
You'll understand someday. What you've [sine]missed[/sine].
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.THESORCERESSMOD-THE_S: Architect! This madness has to end!
Somehow, I don't think you do.
It seems I am plagued by bothersome crows. How unfortunate for me that I have to kill you again.
Death does not scare me. And neither do you.
I won't falter in the face of evil.
Strike me down again! You will not stay my hand!
Why do you insist on this fruitless battle?
Because this world can be better. And I would fall a thousand times if even just once will make it that way.
I will tear down everything you've built with my own bloody talons, if that's what it takes.
VAKUU.talk.THESORCERESSMOD-THE_SORCERESS: Look at you, hotshot. Why don't you sign right here and we'll get you some real [sine]power[/sine]?
Do I look like a fool to you?
What, you want me to give you the hard sell? Fine! First one's [jitter][b]free[/b][/jitter].

Well if it isn't my favorite firebrand!
That was sarcasm. Take your pick and go.
It's a shame you won't work with me. You'd make a great [sine]tyrant[/sine].

No gods and no masters.
For all people, not just me.
Yeah, you're a real bird of the people. But I've seen that flame of yours before.
The little voice that crackles in the embers of your soul... it ain't singing of [sine]liberation[/sine].
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.THESOR: Come, sister, and be well met. This crossroads has room for a fellow practitioner.
I am humbled by your hospitality. Though I do not know that we practice the same art.
In the realm of magick, no. The spark you carry is of a [i]profane[/i] sort, mortal that you are.
But for the other arts we share, I am glad to offer respite.
There is a place for you in sisterhood. Do not forget it.
You're passing through often, I've noticed. Do not be discouraged. The task wasn't meant to be finished with a single blow.
Then I will finish it with many. Giving in wouldn't make for a worthy ending.
You know, for all my bluster... I do miss my enemies dying when I put a knife through their heart.
Ah, mortals. I forget how unprepared you are for these things. Well, perhaps a touch of witchcraft will help where sorcery proves insufficient.
HADESANCIENTS-APHRODITE_ANCIENT.talk.THE: Oh, my. I must say, it's not my usual style, but you do carry yourself admirably, dear raven.
I take the compliment graciously. It is more effort than any realize, conjuring an effortless beauty.
A pleasure to meet once more, my pretty bird.

Understated works well for you, I can't deny it.
But a little more [i]feather[/i] in the right places might slow your enemies down just that little bit longer.
I appreciate the vote of confidence. But I'm afraid there are very few things in this tower whose attention I'd care to attract.
HADESANCIENTS-ATHENA_ANCIENT.talk.THESOR: Strange times these are, to find ourselves relying on mortal aid. You'd best not squander my boons.
It is ony we mortals with lives to put on the line. What would you be goddess of, without our blood and our labor?
You are an impudent beast. I will hope that means you are an effective one.
Loathe as I am to admit it... I appreciate your efforts in our struggle.
God or mortal, we share a goal. If you ask no more, neither shall I.
HADESANCIENTS-DIONYSUS_ANCIENT.talk.THES: Rare to see such a fetching harpy! Come, share a drink, it's the least I can offer!
I make it a rule to be the least inebriated person in a room. So I suppose I can afford to indulge.
Rare to see such a fetching harpy! Come, share—oh. Places to be, stranger?
Ah... hello? Do I know you?
Perhaps it's for the best you do not.
HADESANCIENTS-HEPHAESTUS_ANCIENT.talk.TH: We're sending you out with wee little butterknives? So much for killin' that Architect.
They've served me well over the years. And I've grown quite comfortable with them.
[i]Eh[/i], like I haven't heard [i]that[/i] before. Well, fine. I'll at least get 'em sharpened.
All right, [i]Sorceress[/i]. I know you ain't plannin' to magick your way to victory, so let's get you armed.
I s'pose I should admit, there's more to those blades than I thought at first glance. History, if nothin' else.
History, yes. And little of it to be proud of.
[i]Tch...[/i] They're war-knives, sister. Wouldn't be worth a damn if they didn't have blood on 'em.
HADESANCIENTS-POSEIDON_ANCIENT.talk.THES: Well met, warrior! Odd to think I'd be fighting with a creature of the sky, but war makes strange bedfellows, no? Let's see what I can cook up for one such as yourself, hm?
(I can't even get a word in... I musn't underestimate the gods.)
We meet again! I'll make this quick, then, and send you along your way. Wouldn't want your feathers to get waterlogged, now would we? Ha ha!
You do realize we corvus can't fly, yes? And ravens are hardly a strange sight by the water. They're clever at catching fish, among other things.
So your people plunder my domain? A strange case to make, if you wish to win my favor.
A bird is hardly [i]my people[/i] any more than an ape would be a human's.
Ha! You took me seriously, didn't you? Lighten up, my feathered friend! Here, let me offer a gift, by way of apology for my little jest.
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.THESORCE: My greetings, dear lady. I've been watching you fight valiantly for our cause, and I confess to you, my heart has been moved. Please, allow me to repay your efforts by granting you my finest boon.
I appreciate your gracious offer. I'm sure I can find good use for a bolt of lightning cast along my daggers.
Ah—of course. The boon of my thunderous might. Yes, a fine choice choice indeed. I am certain it will serve you well.
We meet again, my fair Sorceress! You will need my blessing to carry you through these hardships, and it is my honor to provide.
I don't wish to sound uncourteous, my fair raven. But I've gone to quite a lot of trouble to offer you these boons, and I fear at times my gestures of appreciation are not being reciprocated.
It is a shame to hear you feel that way, o God of Gods. Have you spoken to you wife about these feelings?

Well, come, now, I need not burden Hera—dear, sweet Hera, my beloved rock in even the hardest times—with all my petty troubles.
No, in fact, I think she needn't hear about this at all. Don't you agree? You have a job to be doing, after all. Let me fashion you with my boon and send you on your way.
SARAKTTHECUBE-SARAKT.talk.THESORCERESSMO:
I know what you are, with that little scrap of nothing aflame inside your chest.
You'd destroy this world if given half the chance.
Your world, perhaps. But [i]this[/i] world belongs to its people. So long as any shred of me remains, I will fight for their right to build anew.

And you think your will is stronger than that thing inside you? I'm almost amused.
Fine then, voidchild. Go and prove me wrong.

Fashioning you with tools of destruction feels unwise.
But I'm too magnanimous a host to leave you empty-handed.

You haven't managed to bring reality collapsing down upon us yet.
I should take that as a blessing.
I'm certain I'll get around to it any day now.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-MITHRIX_ANCIENT.talk.TH: Now the vermin track feathers through my domain. You all grow more disgusting with every passing day.
I lack the strength to strike you down for your words. But you lack the conviction to harm my pride.
[b]Feh.[/b] Take your treasure, then, and we'll see where your "conviction" gets you.
There is no need to call me vermin this time. I'll do my business and be on my way.
You think wriggling about more efficiently makes you a noble worm?
I think you have been alone for a long time. Clinging to your stubborn sense of superiority as a last bulwark against the despair of this empty world.
And the last thing I need is to spend my time contemplating your wretched fate.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-LESHY_ANCIENT.talk.THES: Come in, weary stranger. Can I interest you in a game of cards?
I suppose can spare a round. There's no need to rush to the top.
Lovely, just lovely. But keep your cards away from your sleeves, trickster. I won't warn you twice.
Somebody's looking deadly today. Need anything sharp 'n' pointy, killer?

My charms don't begin and end at the point of a knife.
...But I won't turn down a blade if you have one.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-LUNATIC_CULTIST_ANCIENT: [i][font_size=22]The Sorceress takes one look around and decides she wants nothing to do with this.[/font_size][/i]
[i][font_size=22]But she does help herself to a little something on the way out. Better that it's in her hands than theirs, anyway.[/font_size][/i]
NINOMAE_INA_NIS_ANCIENT-NINOMAE_INA_NIS_:
A bird. With fire magic. And a little hat.
...
No, no, you're too sleek. I can't see it even if I squint.
I do not know what you're talking about.
Very well. A blessing for the daring magician.
You're clever, little trickster. But you're a fragile thing. If you go down too deep, your hollow bones will snap under the pressure.
Are you sure your cause is worth it?

If I still fought for myself, even my pride would buckle in the face of the impossible.
But I am fighting for the future. And what drives me now is stronger than mere ego.
VAKUU.talk.NECRONOMICON_THESORCERESSMOD-: What, you're too good to make a deal with me, but you'll go and pick up [jitter]that[/jitter] thing?
You resent that I won't let you control me. The book won't control me, either.

You think if you say it with enough conviction, it'll be true. It's worked for you so far, right?
But there's powers in this world greater than magic, girl. You don't wanna learn that the hard way.
VAKUU.talk.NECRONOMICON_MAXED_THESORCERE: Poor, stupid little bird. You think you're too smart for a deal with the devil. But just look at you now.
I've done what I must to get this far. I'll do what I must to go further. And whatever challenge I face, I will find a way to triumph.
You will [b]fall[/b], Sorceress. To a depth you can't even [b][jitter]imagine[/jitter][/b].
NONUPEIPE.talk.NECRONOMICON_THESORCERESS: Darling... please tell me you didn't.

There is nothing to worry about. I realize the book's terms are... unfavorable.
But I do not operate on the book's terms. I operate on my own.
I dearly hope that you're right. For our sake, if not for yours.
NONUPEIPE.talk.NECRONOMICON_MAXED_THESOR: My pretty little bird... what have you done?
Nothing I can't talk my way out of once more.
Oh, my darling... not this time.
TANX.talk.NECRONOMICON_THESORCERESSMOD-T: SORCERESS!! EVIL BOOK! DON'T READ IT!!!
I'm not sure reading it is really necessary for the magic, to be honest.
OF COURSE NOT!! READING IS FOR NERDS!!!
TANX.talk.NECRONOMICON_MAXED_THESORCERES: BIRD LADY! A MIGHTY FOE WAITS AHEAD!! IT WILL KILL YOU!!!
A mighty enough foe to interest even the legendary Tanx...?
FUCK NO DO YOU THINK I'M CRAZY???
